title: FW↔PO-001: Feature Requirements + Firmware Effort Estimates
description: Product Owner/TPM provides feature requirements + acceptance criteria for firmware-delivered capability and the OTA release-train schedule; Firmware returns milestone status, integration-readiness dates, effort estimates, and known firmware risks/blockers. Grounded in PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.3.

feature_requirements.description: PO→FW: feature requirements with acceptance criteria.

acceptance_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria (capability framing, not implementation spec).

firmware_feedback.description: FW→PO: milestone status, readiness, effort, and risks.

critical_path_impact.description: Whether a slip affects the critical path (immediate escalation required if true).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Sprint-level feature intake and status reporting are agent-autonomous. Milestone slippage on the critical path triggers immediate escalation (may classify Tier-2).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (sprint-level sync — standups / sprint review); immediate escalation on milestone slippage affecting the critical path
confirm_conditions: each feature_requirement carries a feature_id, ≥20-char acceptance_criteria, and a priority
SLIPPED status carries an updated integration_readiness_date and critical_path_impact flag
effort_estimate provided in person-days where requested
reject_conditions: acceptance_criteria expressed as a firmware implementation directive PO does not own (overreach)
milestone_status = SLIPPED on the critical path without escalation
feature accepted into a sprint without acceptance criteria
counter_conditions: acceptance criteria ambiguous or untestable — request clarification before commitment
OTA release-train date conflicts with the integration-readiness date — request re-sequencing
